source.document: Commission Decision of 31.7.2024 amending Commission Decision C(2021)35 authorising the use of unit costs for travel, accommodation and subsistence costs under an action or work programme under the 2021-2027 multiannual financial framework
source.version: C(2024) 5405 final. Published as one consolidated PDF (38 pp.) that also holds C(2023)4928 and C(2021)35. PDF dated 2024-07-31. Downloaded 2026-11-08.
source.applies_to: Award procedures (calls) launched or opened after 31.7.2024. Corporate decision covering Horizon Europe/Euratom and other 2021-2027 programmes.
source.page_reference_note: 'annex p.' = printed page number in the C(2024)5405 Annex; 'pdf p.' = page in the downloaded PDF.

supplementary_sources.document: EU Grants: Additional Information on Unit Costs and Contributions — Annex 2a and 2b, V1.11 – 01.05.2026
supplementary_sources.why: The C(2024)5405 Annex (points 3.2-3.4) gives no accommodation or subsistence amounts. It sets them equal to the Staff Regulations Annex VII Art. 13 hotel ceilings and daily allowances (Delegated Reg. (EU) 2016/1611) and C(2002)98, updated automatically, with the C(2021)35 point 5.5 amounts as a floor. The applicable rates are published on the Funding & Tenders Portal, in Annex 2a to the Model Grant Agreement.

tables.title: 5.1 Amounts for return air and combined air/rail journey
tables.distance_basis: One-way distance between departure and arrival point, measured with the EC rail/flight calculator (https://ec.europa.eu/info/calculate-unit-costs-eligible-travel-costs_en).
tables.notes: Bands are inclusive (400-600, 601-1600, ...). to_km null means no upper limit ('Max'). Air travel under 400 km is allowed only in exceptional cases, at actual cost.

tables.title: 5.2 Amounts for intra-Member State return journeys by land
tables.notes: CY, LU and MT are not listed. amount_400_600_km exists only for DE, ES, FI, FR, IT, PL, SE; null elsewhere (actual costs). Car travel is capped at the 50-399 km amount.

tables.title: 5.3 Amounts per return trip for inter-Member State land-based journeys with one-way distances of 50-399 km or 400-600 km
tables.notes: The source matrix is symmetric, so each pair is listed once (country_code_a < country_code_b). A source cell 'x/y' means x for 50-399 km and y for 400-600 km. Unlisted pairs have no unit cost (actual costs). IE, CY and MT are not in the matrix.

tables.title: 5.4 Amounts for land-based journeys between Member States and bordering countries
tables.notes: One amount per Member State covers all its listed borders. amount_400_600_km null = '-' in the source.

tables.title: Accommodation and subsistence unit costs (calls with opening date as from 13 May 2025)
tables.annex: C(2024)5405 Annex, points 3.2-3.4 (method); amounts from Annex 2a V1.11, 'Travel and subsistence' section
tables.pages: accommodation pp. 13-17; subsistence pp. 21-24 of Annex 2a V1.11
tables.notes: 'Other Countries' applies to any country not listed. country_code is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, except EL (Greece) and UK (United Kingdom) as in EU tables, and null where no single code fits. Decimals (Andorra, Monaco, San Marino, Vatican City) are as printed. 'Netherlands Antilles' shows '---' for this period and is left out.
